Notes

Ferumbras Mortal Shell is the last stage of Ferumbras during the Ferumbras' Ascendant Quest.

Location

Halls of Ascension.

Behaviour

Does not retarget very often.

Strategy

Lure it to the south-west corner of the room and them just keep attacking it. It's strong to most elements but takes considerable Physical Damage. See the quest spoiler for a detailed strategy.

History

  • On November 28, 2022, the Winter Update 2022 reduced its cooldown from 14 days to 13 days and 20 hours.
  • As announced on March 12, 2024, the patch raised its experience from 100,000 to 500,000 as part of the 2024 Balancing Project.
  • On April 09, 2024, the patch raised its experience once again, this time from 500,000 to 2,000,000 as part of the 2024 Balancing Project.
